data.one_liner: Vector tile layer for flutter_map with MapLibre-style rendering and isolate decoding.
data.what_it_does: Renders MapLibre and Mapbox GL vector tile styles inside a flutter_map layer. It performs isolate-based tile decoding, GPU-resident raster caching, and screen-space label collision.
use_when: You are building a flutter_map application and need to render vector tiles from MVT sources or PMTiles.
You want support for MapLibre styles, sprites, and custom glyph fonts without heavy native dependencies.
avoid_when: Your project does not use flutter_map.
You need native Google Maps integration rather than OpenStreetMap/vector tile providers.
strengths: Self-contained package handling MVT decoding, style engines, and rasterization.
Runs tile decoding on worker isolates and supports multiple platforms including web and desktop.
Deterministic LRU memory and disk caching with offline support.
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the flutter_map ecosystem.
High concurrent decoding and raster caching can consume significant memory on mobile devices.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_map and flutter_map_vector_tiles to pubspec.yaml and load a style using StyleReader.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Google's native map renderer over flutter_map and vector tiles.
